_comment: CPU instruction and memory ceilings for the coverage-ledger calls that matter on other contracts' hot paths. Measured natively by the resource-budget tests in contracts/coverage-ledger/src/test.rs, with about 20% headroom over the cost on 2026-11-21. Raise a ceiling deliberately, in the commit that needs the room, so growth is argued for rather than absorbed. post_reserve raised on 2026-11-25 for the per-asset reporter cap (#109): a reporter new to an asset now costs one more cross-contract read, reporter-registry.max_reporters, plus the reads that count the asset's reporters. Re-measure on the next run of the budget tests and tighten it.
